catalog.title: Seiko V2
catalog.edition: export edition (USA, Seiko Time Corporation, New York)
catalog.note: US dealer catalogue 'Seiko — The Automation Age Watch' of Seiko Time Corporation, 640 Fifth Avenue, New York (printed pp.1–34 + covers). Each caption prints the US stock number ('No. 54101M') with the retail price in US dollars, the case and dial and, where the section header does not give them, jewels (J) and features; the M suffix marks the bracelet version. Section headers state jewels, winding, water resistance and calendar for the whole group, and those are copied into each record. It prints no case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs, calibers or bracelet codes; p.34 is the QC-951-11 quartz crystal chronometer (a portable clock). The two cover watches have no caption and are not recorded. Dating: the stopwatch copy names Seiko official timer of the 1972 Winter Olympics and the range includes the electronic BP models (dial EL-370), so this edition is probably 1971–72 rather than 1969; the year follows the source file. Several stock numbers repeat from the Seiko V1 catalogue at different prices. Dial colours come from the captions where printed, otherwise from the photos.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops.
